mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deployments ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, created_by_api_key_uuid, environment_uuid, environment_external_id, agent_uuid, agent_external_id, agent_version, agent_snapshot, name, description, metadata, initial_events, resources, resource_secrets, vault_ids, schedule, last_run_at, status, paused_reason, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.CreatedByAPIKeyUUID}, #{params.EnvironmentUUID}, #{params.EnvironmentExternalID}, #{params.AgentUUID}, #{params.AgentExternalID}, #{params.AgentVersion}, CAST(#{params.AgentSnapshot,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), #{params.Name}, #{params.Description}, (CAST(#{params.Metadata,sensitive=true} AS jsonb) - '_oma_runtime_user_uuid') || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('_oma_runtime_user_uuid', CAST(#{params.RuntimeUserUUID} AS text))), CAST(#{params.InitialEvents,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.Resources,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.ResourceSecrets,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.VaultIDs,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.Schedule,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), #{params.LastRunAt}, #{params.Status}, CAST(#{params.PausedReason,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING
